name: Mobile app
description: An Expo (React Native) client for iPhone, iPad and Android in mobile/
details: Adds an Expo SDK 57 app in mobile/ built on deepspace/native: Google sign-in through the system browser with PKCE, the app's real-time record room, integrations and server actions. The app id and name come from wrangler.toml, and mobile/ pins the same deepspace version as the app. No Xcode project is checked in; npx expo run:ios or EAS Build generates it.

code.insert:
// mobile/ is the Expo client, with its own toolchain.
  { ignores: ['mobile/**'] },

instructions: Allowlist the native callback in wrangler.toml: NATIVE_AUTH_REDIRECT_URIS = "<scheme>://auth/callback", where <scheme> is the app name without dashes (mobile/app.config.ts names it if missing). Deploy the Worker after changing it.
Set your own iOS bundle identifier and Android package in mobile/app.config.ts before building for a device.
cd mobile && npm install && npx expo run:ios starts a development build in the iOS Simulator.
patterns: Import everything native from deepspace/native: the client, DeepSpaceNativeProvider, RecordProvider, RecordScope, useQuery, useMutations, integration and callAction.
The schemas array passed to RecordScope is the same one the Worker uses; import it from ../src rather than copying it.
Integration results with data.requiresOAuth carry an authUrl: open it with openIntegrationConsent, then retry the call.
agentNotes: mobile/ is a separate npm project; run its installs and type-checks from inside mobile/.
Use a development build to test sign-in. Expo Go cannot receive the custom-scheme callback.
When the root app's deepspace version changes, update mobile/package.json to the same version.
